label: Bible Study
prompt: All we like _____ have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verse: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
note: The suffering servant chapter — we wander like sheep; he carries the iniquity.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is good unto them that _____ for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
verse: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
note: Waiting is the one spiritual discipline nobody volunteers for, and the LORD is good in it.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Pride goeth before _____, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verse: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
note: Everyone quotes 'pride goeth before a fall,' but the KJV says destruction first — the fall comes in the second half.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Where there is no _____, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verse: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
note: 'Vision' here is prophetic revelation — without a word from God, a people unravels.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And as he reasoned of righteousness, _____, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
verse: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
note: Paul preached self-control — 'temperance' — to a governor who had none, and Felix trembled.
